units.source_text: 忽地，他站住了，草根处有什么东西动了一下。

en.t: Suddenly, he stopped; something moved at the roots of the grass.

units.source_text: 仔细一看，原来是只蜘蛛。

en.t: Looking more closely, he saw that it was only a spider.
Catching a spider would be no use.

units.source_text: 于是，他打算稍事休息，席地坐了下来。

en.t: So he decided to rest for a little while and sat down on the ground.

units.source_text: 风不间断地从海上吹来，眼前，细碎的白浪花，噬咬着遥远的沙丘脚。

en.t: The wind blew in steadily from the sea, and before his eyes small white breakers gnawed at the foot of the distant dunes.

units.source_text: 西面角上沙丘的尽头，有一座剥露出岩石表面的小高丘，面对大海突出向前。

en.t: At the western corner, where the dunes came to an end, a small hill with exposed rock jutted out toward the sea.

units.source_text: 小高丘顶上，太阳光像扎成的一束箭，撒满一片天空。

en.t: Above the little hill, sunlight spread across the sky like a bundled sheaf of arrows.
